About.heading: About
About.para1: Hi, I'm Andrew, an English and French speaking software developer based in Civray. I build custom web applications, SaaS products and AI tools for businesses in Sud Vienne, Poitiers, Angoulême and across Nouvelle-Aquitaine, from online shops that replaced WooCommerce to an e-invoicing platform built for the 2026 French mandate.
About.para2: If your business runs on spreadsheets, copy-pasting or a tool that almost fits, I can build something that does exactly what you need, and you own the code. I also provide IT support for local businesses and individuals. Get in touch using the form below or through my social media, links in the header.

Portfolio.anteluxia: A calming site for an animal communication and holistic wellbeing practice in South West France. Built with Next.js 16 and Stripe for secure online payments, in a warm forest-and-gold palette with light and dark modes. Fully bilingual (English and French) and responsive across every screen, including touch-screen laptops.
Portfolio.einvoicer: A SaaS product for EU-compliant electronic invoicing. Generates Factur-X (PDF/A-3) and Peppol BIS 3.0 documents, integrates with the French Super PDP network, and handles regulated VAT submission flows — built to meet French and EU e-invoicing mandates coming into force from 2026.
Portfolio.silsoup: Custom online shop built to replace a WooCommerce site — sells RFID readers, and electronics with a flexible product options system that lets the owner configure variants and pricing without developer help. Includes a full admin dashboard, live PayPal checkout, and customer reviews. Hosted on a dedicated server for full control and no monthly platform fees. Written in ViteJs, backend Golang
Portfolio.gardapis: A full e-commerce store for a French beekeeping products brand. Built on a custom server with a product admin dashboard, the storefront supports 6 languages, bulk discount pricing, product options, verified customer reviews, and PayPal checkout — all hosted on a dedicated server for around €13 per month.
Portfolio.sage: A welcoming website for a language school in South West France offering English and French courses. Fully bilingual so visitors can browse in either language, with easy-to-use contact forms and everything in place to rank well on Google search results.
Portfolio.tc: A portfolio site for Terry Carroll, a photographer based in Bristol, UK. Features six themed galleries with a masonry layout and lightbox viewer, all images hosted and optimised via Cloudinary. An admin dashboard lets Terry upload new photos directly without touching any code.
Portfolio.carpetco: Professional carpet fitting service in Dukinfield and Greater Manchester. Modern, responsive website built with Next.js 16, featuring service showcases, contact forms, and SEO optimization. Clean design focused on conversion and easy navigation for local customers.
Portfolio.nd: Nature Dopes is an ongoing project dedicated to creating a site firstly for the appreciation of natural flora, secondly as an educational tool. To preserve the environment, we first need to understand it. It's a full stack application developed in NextJs 14 Typescipt, It utilizes many of the latest NextJs tools, such as Next-auth for authentification, Next-intl for multi language, Radix Ui, Iagon for decentralized storage and Prisma for Database management. Follow the link to view
Portfolio.pop: This is the homepage page for a new startup business offering childcare options for weddings and large events, please give them a look if you have any major events planned in South West France. The site is a web application developed in NextJs 14 and uses Next-Int for intuitive language switching. Follow the link to view
Portfolio.pocket: This is a complete site redesign for an upcoming Web 3 gaming and NFT project called Pocket Towne. Developed in HTML, CSS , Javascript. Please check them out if you're interested in Metaverse & web 3
Portfolio.space: S.P.A.C.E is an NFT Art/ Utility project. I've developed a landing page to serve as the homepage for the project. The site has been developed using NextJs, using React hooks & components to give the site a responsive and animated feel.

faq.a: One well-built page is enough for most trades and shops. The package goes up to three pages. For more pages, an online shop or bookings, I'll quote separately.

It depends on the package. A small business website is a one-off payment: hosting is free on your own account, and only the domain name renews each year, usually around ten euros. A bigger site, with an online shop, bookings or a client area, needs paid hosting and upkeep, so it comes with a monthly plan. I'll tell you clearly which applies before we start.

faq.q: What if I need changes later?
faq.a: You can ask me for changes by the hour, or choose a monthly plan that includes small updates.

faq.q: Do you work with English-speaking businesses?
faq.a: Yes. I'm British and I work in English and French every day. Several of my clients are British-run businesses in the Vienne and the Charente.
